descriptor.name: City of Surrey cadastral lots
descriptor.scope: City of Surrey municipal lots in the COSMOS GIS; bounded local qualification only.

evidence: Frozen Surrey service review identifies the City GIS/Engineering COSMOS property-map custodian and municipal lots polygons; it does not claim land-title authority or citywide completeness.

https://www.surrey.ca/services-payments/online-services/maps-cosmos identifies the City of Surrey Mapping Online System, property-map functions, and GIS data derived from legal plans, confirming municipal property-map purpose and geographic scope.

Official https://gisservices.surrey.ca/arcgis/rest/services/ICI_Data/MapServer/1 exposes municipal lot polygons with LTSA lot/block/plan/parcel and PID schema, corroborating the frozen parcel-purpose evidence; unchanged frozen sample geometries and the unchanged WUP point are verified locally.
